chunks: Sa'd and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, together, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Al-Husayn ibn Ali عليه السلام passed away on the day of Ashura, and he was fifty-seven years old.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Imam al-Husayn, son of Imam Ali عليهما السلام
key_terms.عَاشُورَاءَ: the tenth day of Muharram, associated with the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام
key_terms.قُبِضَ: was taken; a reverential expression for passing away

ai.seo_question: On what day did Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali عليه السلام was taken on the day of Ashura at the age of fifty-seven. It is a brief biographical report preserving a foundational historical detail concerning the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام.
